SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.
   D. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   C. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.
   B. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.
   D. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

7. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal relationships.
   B. Treat Diversity and interpersonal relationships as rumours only.
   C. Say Diversity and interpersonal relationships never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.
   C. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.

9. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.
   D. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

12. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.
   C. Treat Peaceful Coexistence as rumours only.
   D. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fieldwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Political Development in Africa 5 5.2 The Constitution of Kenya 5 5.3 Human Righ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Political Development in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Constitution of Kenya 5 5.3 Human Rights 5 5.4 African Diasporas 5 5.5 Citiz and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
